Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride

Scarsdale, NY

No-drop

Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride is a road group ride in Scarsdale, NY. It meets every Sunday in summer, meet 9:00 am, roll 9:30 am, starting at Danny's Cycles Scarsdale. Expect about 30–35 miles, 12–15 mph.

About the Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride group ride

A no-drop Sunday morning shop ride out of Scarsdale, open to anyone, not just customers. Fair-weather only. The shop also runs Saturday gravel/road rides and an MTB ride from Mohegan Lake.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
